name: dsh-conv-export
description: dsh-conv-export（对话导出）— export the current conversation, or a single assistant turn, as Markdown, single-file HTML, PDF, or a long PNG image, or copy it as Markdown. Batch export removed in this fork.
author: beijingwahw

privacy.note: 纯浏览器端导出：点击时刻从渲染 DOM 提取，不经宿主服务、无出站网络请求、无存储域、无追踪代码；本 fork 已移除上游的 /conv-export 宿主端点（webServer/sessionQuery 权限随之删除）。
